aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome for Android led browser versions (mobile) in Germany at 61.93% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari iPhone ranked second at 21.25%, followed by Chrome for iPhone at 5.72%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (mobile) in Germany?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android leads at 61.93% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/mobile/germany.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (mobile) in Germany?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (61.93%), Safari iPhone (21.25%), Chrome for iPhone (5.72%) in October 2026.
